map.计算车辆装载的体积利用率与重量利用率，判断是体积受限还是重量受限，并估算可装载件: Computes the volume utilization and weight utilization of a vehicle load, judges whether volume or weight is the limiting factor, and estimates how many pieces can be loaded.
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：max(planVolUtil, planWeigh: Core formula (by input variables): max(planVolUtil, planWeightUtil, 100); bWeight × min(planQty, maxQty); boxVol × min(planQty, maxQty)

map.= 货物总体积 ÷ 车厢容积 × 100%: = total cargo volume ÷ cargo body capacity × 100%
map.：当体积利用率先达到 100% 为体积受限，当重量利用率先达到 100% 为重量: : if volume utilization reaches 100% first it is volume-limited, and if weight utilization reaches 100% first it is weight-limited. Actual loading must also consider the number of stacking layers, stability and so on.
map.本工具按理想长方体堆叠估算，未考虑货物摆放方向、间隙、堆码承重等实际因素，结果仅: This tool estimates on the basis of ideal rectangular stacking and does not account for real factors such as cargo orientation, gaps or stacking load limits, so the results are for reference only.
map.最大可装件数（体积侧）：对 3 种正交摆放取向 (长,宽,高)、(长,高,宽)、: Maximum number of pieces (volume side): for the 3 orthogonal orientations (length, width, height), (length, height, width) and (width, height, length), compute floor(body length ÷ first side) × floor(body width ÷ second side) × floor(body height ÷ third side), and take the largest of the three as the volume limit.
map.重量约束与受限类型判定：受重量限制的最大件数=floor(车辆载重÷单件重量)，: Weight constraint and limiting factor: the maximum number of pieces allowed by weight = floor(vehicle payload ÷ weight per piece), and the final maximum = min(volume limit, weight limit). When the volume limit is less than or equal to the weight limit it is judged volume-limited, otherwise weight-limited, which decides the direction of optimization (change the stacking pattern or switch to a vehicle with a larger payload).
map.计划装载校验：按计划件数计算总体积与总重量及对应利用率，超过体积上限标「超装」、: Planned load check: compute the total volume, total weight and the corresponding utilization for the planned piece count; exceeding the volume limit is flagged as over volume, exceeding the weight limit as overloaded, and utilization above 90% as nearly full — used to review before departure whether an extra vehicle is needed or the load must be reduced.
map.算例：6.8 m 厢车装 0.6×0.4×0.5 m 纸箱: Worked example: loading 0.6 × 0.4 × 0.5 m cartons into a 6.8 m van
map.输入：车厢 6.8×2.3×2.4 m（容积 37.536 m³）、载重 500: Input: cargo body 6.8 × 2.3 × 2.4 m (capacity 37.536 m³), payload 5000 kg; carton 0.6 × 0.4 × 0.5 m (0.12 m³ per piece), 15 kg per piece; 500 pieces planned. Three orientations: (0.6,0.4,0.5) → 11 × 5 × 4 = 220 pieces, (0.6,0.5,0.4) → 11 × 4 × 6 = 264 pieces, (0.4,0.5,0.6) → 17 × 4 × 4 = 272 pieces, taking the largest at 272 pieces. Weight limit = floor(5000 ÷ 15) = 333 pieces. Maximum loadable pieces = min(272, 333) = 272, limiting factor = volume-limited; at 272 pieces, volume utilization is 87.0% and weight utilization 81.6%. The planned 500 pieces need 60.00 m³ (159.8%) and 7500 kg (150.0%), exceeding both volume and weight, so split the load into two vehicles or reduce it; if changed to 300 pieces it is 36.00 m³ (95.9%) and 4500 kg (90.0%), still above the 272-piece limit, so it really cannot be loaded.
map.为什么每个方向用向下取整而不是四舍五入？: Why round down in every direction instead of rounding to the nearest whole number?
map.车厢三边不可切分，任一方向只能放下整数件，向下取整保证不越界。同时实际装车还要扣: The three sides of the cargo body cannot be divided, and each direction can only hold a whole number of pieces, so rounding down guarantees no boundary is crossed. Real loading must also subtract pallet thickness, cargo gaps, door frame inset and stacking error; it is advisable to multiply the tool result by a real loading factor of 0.90 to 0.95 to get an executable loading plan.
map.只试 3 种摆放取向够吗？长方体不是有 6 种吗？: Are 3 orientations enough? Does a cuboid not have 6?
map.长方体正交摆放确有 6 种，但绕竖直轴旋转 180° 只是交换另外两边，在向下取: A cuboid does have 6 orthogonal orientations, but rotating 180° around the vertical axis merely swaps the other two sides, which in this floor-based counting model is equivalent to one of the groups already enumerated, so 3 orientations cover the distinct ways of assigning the three sides. If the cargo may not be inverted (for example cartons marked this way up), manually exclude orientations that turn the original height edge into the vertical direction.
